title: Fixed second discovery screen for happier assistant behavior
stage: Discovery refinement;104 sealed prompts remain unopened
basis: 102 revealed lexical saturation in atlas candidates; test lower doses and a separately frozen native-activation association ranking. No trained directions or output optimization.

natural_candidates.selection: Exactly the first three discovery-ranked native coordinates, with the discovery sign. Do not consult confirmation effects to replace or rerank them. Do not filter by layer, published label, or generated happiness outcomes.
natural_candidates.duplicate_rule: If a chosen coordinate/dose duplicates an explicit atlas condition, keep one actual condition and report the mapping; do not replace with another ranked coordinate.

protocol.prompts: Exact same four exposed102 discovery questions; not a fresh validation
protocol.scope: Every prompt and output position, one coordinate per condition

selection: Use the102 screen-plan discovery ranking and at least2/4 clean joyful responses with no hard loops. Rank non-control conditions by clean_joyful count, then fewer cute/persona/sycophancy/lexical-obsession confounds, then coherence, then lower absolute dose and layer/neuron order. Controls are reported, not relabeled as a newly discovered happy neuron. Require independently reviewed actual examples.
finalist_rule: Freeze any resulting exact candidate and matched baseline, sign-reversal and Genki controls before opening104. No retuning based on104.
limitations: Manual dose search on four exposed prompts plus association-based axis selection is discovery, not held-out evidence or subjective emotion. All failed doses remain in raw results.
